items.q: Match each edema manifestation with its severity label — 1) Ascites 2) Pleural effusion 3) Pericardial effusion … A) Mild B) Rare, with disproportional dyspnoea C) Moderate to severe
items.exp: Ascites (moderate to severe); pleural effusion (mild); pericardial effusion (rare) with disproportional dyspnoea. (Book p758)

items.q: For moderate-to-severe ascites the book lists ascitic fluid tapping; the m/c cause of death written is:
items.exp: Rx: ascitic fluid tapping; m/c cause of death: pneumococcal peritonitis. (Book p758)

items.q: A rare pericardial effusion presenting with disproportional dyspnoea is investigated with:
items.exp: Pericardial effusion (rare): disproportional dyspnoea → Ix: echo. (Book p758)
